name: data-batch-processing
description: Use when the user asks about Hive, HiveQL, Spark SQL batch jobs, Hive metastore, partitioning and bucketing, ORC vs Parquet for batch, Catalyst/AQE tuning or dynamic partition pruning. Produces batch job designs with table layout, file format and query tuning steps. Not for choosing Spark vs Dask vs Ray (use data-distributed-compute) or real-time pipelines (use data-streaming).
